Dana, I haven't emailed Thea. Mail to anyone outside pemberline.com, even as a draft, needs Ruth Calloway's approval first. I've logged that request with Ruth and replied in your thread, and nothing is sent or drafted until she says yes.

The two lines I'd send Thea, taken from #inc-qfl-sev1:
1. The Superior dock-schedule sync stopped at about 6:40 AM Superior local time on 4 Nov, going by your report in the channel.
2. Samir's hotfix was deployed and the replay finished at 2:38 PM that day, going by the channel timestamp. Superior dock schedules were syncing cleanly again from then.

Ruth isn't in #north-team, so she may not see my reply in your thread. If you ping her directly, that should speed things up. Since Thea is waiting, a quick call to her in the meantime might also help.
